verdict.rationale: The evidence describes New Relic only as a hosted SaaS platform, and nothing documents a local, self-hosted, or spin-up dev instance of the platform itself. The perpetual free tier is a hosted account, not an instance. `nr1 nerdpack:serve` only serves custom Nerdpack UI apps for testing, which is adjacent to the story rather than a platform instance. Community reports go the other way: New Relic "removed development mode" and charges for development environments.

support.subject: As a developer, I can spin up a local or dev instance of the platform to test instrumentation and dashboards
